headline: Earnings jump from last year even as cash cushion thins
summary_short: Revenue was $1,986M, +18.9% y/y but -6.3% q/q; diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 97.5% y/y yet fell 13.8% q/q, and operating cash flow swung to -$242M from +$17M a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,986M, up 18.9% y/y but down 6.3% q/q. Gross margin rose to 86.2%, up ~340bp q/q and ~290bp y/y despite the revenue pullback. Net margin was 20.0%, down ~175bp q/q but up ~800bp y/y. Diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 97.5% y/y (from $0.79) while falling 13.8% q/q (from $1.81). Total cash fell 20.1% q/q to $2,288M from $2,864M, though still up 50.7% y/y from $1,518M. Operating cash flow swung to -$242M from +$17M a year earlier.
